other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.map_tree:
primrec map_tree :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'a tree \<Rightarrow> 'b tree" where
  "map_tree f Leaf = Leaf" |
  "map_tree f (Node l v r) = (Node (map_tree f l) (f v) (map_tree f r))"

formal theorem statement: theorem eq_map_tree_Leaf[simp]: "map_tree f t = Leaf \<longleftrightarrow> t = Leaf"
